name: debatable
description: AI debate simulator - two LLM instances argue PRO and NEG on a topic

scripts.check: bun build --compile --outfile dist/debatable src/index.tsx && oxlint --type-aware --type-check --fix && oxfmt --write && knip && e18e-cli analyze --log-level error && bunx react-doctor --score
scripts.ci: S=$?; bun build --compile --outfile dist/debatable src/index.tsx && oxlint --type-aware --type-check && oxfmt --check && knip && e18e-cli analyze --log-level error || S=$?; react-doctor --score || true; exit $S
